description: This PHP class 'DefaultExceptionSubscriber' handles exceptions in a Drupal JSON:API module, serializing exceptions into JSON:API format and managing HTTP responses accordingly.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: Handles exception serialization for JSON:API compliance within Drupal, extending the serialization exception subscriber.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the exception handler, increasing parent's priority by 25.

methods.name: getHandledFormats
methods.description: Specifies that this handler processes the 'api_json' format.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Main method to handle exceptions, wrapping non-HTTP exceptions into HttpException with status 500.

methods.name: setEventResponse
methods.description: Creates and sets the appropriate JSON:API formatted response based on the exception and request cacheability.

methods.name: isJsonApiExceptionEvent
methods.description: Determines if the exception event should be formatted as JSON:API based on request format or route.
